page.summary: Take a needed unhook, then turn its Fast Track token into permanent progress on a useful generator with a Great basic repair check.

verdict.recommendation: Treat the rescue as the necessary team job first. Fast Track makes your own unhook pay again later, but does not justify a late or unsafe rescue.
verdict.soloQ: Cover a reachable hook only when you can complete the rescue safely, then choose a meaningful generator for the token cash-out.
verdict.coordinatedSwf: Assign the rescuer and next generator so only one player leaves objectives for the hook and the saved repair progress lands on a useful target.
verdict.mainWeakness: No token is earned without your unhook, and the progress requires a later Great basic repair check; a poor target or missed window strands the benefit.

options.whyItsHere: Your unhooks bank up to 1/2/3 tokens. A Great basic repair check spends all held tokens for 5% permanent progress each on that generator.

item.name: Toolbox
item.why: The snapshot permits none or an optional Toolbox. Use finite charges only to complete a selected target; no fixed item or add-on package is established.

opening: Check hook timing, route safety and who else is covering the rescue before leaving a generator. The perk pays for a real unhook, not for hovering near one.

rows.situation: A hooked teammate needs a rescuer, you can reach safely and no better-positioned player has the assignment.
rows.action: Unhook the teammate, then route back toward the most valuable reachable generator. Do not force a rescue through Killer pressure merely to bank a token.
rows.why: Fast Track grants one token for your unhook, up to 1/2/3 by tier, while the rescue itself must still protect team hook economy.

rows.situation: You hold Fast Track tokens and are repairing a generator whose completion still matters.
rows.action: Hit a Great basic repair check to spend every held token for 5% permanent progress each on that generator. If the target is denied or loses value before the check, rotate instead of camping it for the perk.
rows.why: Stored tokens only convert on the specified check, and all spend at once on the current generator.

rows.situation: A selected generator is close enough that Toolbox charges change its finish timing.
rows.action: Spend only the needed charges, then return to the next team job; the item does not generate Fast Track tokens.
rows.why: The Toolbox is optional efficiency, not the rescue-to-repair trigger.

rows.situation: Another teammate owns the save, the hook route is unsafe, or your current generator is critical.
rows.action: Keep the objective covered and hand the rescue to the better-positioned Survivor. Do not duplicate support labor for a speculative token.
rows.why: The strategic conversion works only when the altruism was needed and the later repair opportunity remains real.

abortWhen: Leave a missed or unsafe hook window and plan the next rescue rather than donating another down.
Release a stale generator target if the Killer or map state makes its token cash-out low value.

strengths: A necessary unhook can produce later permanent generator progress.
weaknesses: Requires your own unhooks and later Great basic checks; tokens cannot rescue poor timing or target choice.
commonMistakes: Assuming any teammate's unhook grants your tokens.
Chasing a token through an unsafe hook or spending it on a generator the team no longer needs.
